name: Hummel
verdict: hummel is part of THORNICO, a family-owned Danish conglomerate founded by Thor and Christian Nicholas Stadil. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Danish sportswear brand (Aarhus, founded 1923 in Hamburg as Messmer & Co); part of the Stadil family's THORNICO group since 1999. No state body or fund found anywhere in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN body or major-NGO human-rights finding against hummel or THORNICO found.
